description: This Java class 'LogWrapper' implements the 'LogNode' interface and acts as a wrapper for Android's native 'Log' utility. It forwards log messages to the Android log system and optionally passes them to the next node in a logging chain, enabling flexible and extendable logging. The class includes methods for setting the next node and printing log messages with support for additional context via exceptions.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implements the LogNode interface, and supports chaining for multiple log handlers.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to receive further log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified priority and tag, optionally including a Throwable, and passes it along the chain.
